title: Cut Silence & Trim
description: See the waveform and video thumbnails on a zoomable timeline, adjust exactly what gets cut, then process — audio or video.
dropLabel: Drop your audio or video here or click to browse
dropHint: Videos come back as MP4 without the cut parts
timelineHint: Drag a kept range's edge to adjust it, click a cut (dimmed) part to restore it, double-click inside a kept part to cut it there.

timeline.keptHint: Kept — drag an edge to adjust, double-click to cut here

sampleButton: Mark current moment as silence sample
thresholdSample: Calibrated from your sample · below {{db}} dB
noAudioHint: This file has no audio track — silence detection is unavailable, but you can still cut parts of the video manually on the timeline above.

modeHint.off: No automatic silence cutting — use the timeline above to cut parts by hand.
modeHint.gentle: Cuts only pauses longer than 1 second — safest for natural speech.
modeHint.balanced: Cuts pauses over 0.6s, keeping a little breathing room. Good default.
modeHint.aggressive: Cuts almost every pause — tight, fast-paced result.

nothingToDo: Nothing is cut yet — adjust the timeline above or turn on silence cutting.
nothingToCut: Nothing was cut — kept as is.
